newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania livestock numbers down in March.
newsitem.headline: Romania livestock numbers down in March.

text.p: Romania's livestock numbers fell in March from the same month last year with the total in both private and state sectors on the slide, National Statistics Board (CNS) data showed on Monday.
The CNS said cattle numbers had fallen by 132,200 to 3.59 million at the end of March, while pig numbers had gone down by 53,400 to 8.67 million.
The number of sheep and goats fell to 15.4 million at end-March, 1.2 million down from the equivalent month of 1996.
Data showed the private sector held 91.2 percent of cattle, 61 percent of pigs and 94.3 percent of sheep and goats.
